prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 fantasy anime key visual in super-deformed chibi style, showing a four-member adventuring party rushing diagonally toward the viewer through a bright magical battlefield. The composition contains exactly 4 characters: 1) front lower center, a tiny white-haired mage girl with long pale lavender-white hair, purple eyes, a calm expression, wearing a flowing white robe with gold trim and holding a wand tipped with a glowing pink crystal cube, surrounded by violet magical arcs; 2) middle left, a black-haired schoolgirl samurai with golden-brown eyes, short navy sailor-style uniform, small armor details, and a drawn katana, lunging forward with a determined face; 3) middle right, a blonde elf girl with long wavy hair, pointed ears, blue-green eyes, teal cape, white tunic, dark leggings, and a short wand or rapier casting bright green circular magic sigils; 4) upper right, a stocky red-haired dwarf warrior with spiky topknot, enormous red eyebrows and beard, fierce eyes, dark red samurai armor, shoulder plates, and a sword at his waist, leaning forward protectively. Use four chibi fantasy heroes, with the central mood as energetic heroic adventure. Background: pastel watercolor splashes, star and petal confetti, sparkling particles, faint fantasy castle silhouette on the upper left, faint red torii gate on the upper right, and no readable text. Style: glossy modern Japanese anime, cute RPG party illustration, dynamic diagonal motion, soft rim lighting, vibrant rainbow magic effects, detailed costumes, clean faces with large eyes, high resolution, whimsical and celebratory. Keep the characters fully visible, overlapping but distinct, with the mage closest to the bottom foreground and the dwarf highest in the background. Avoid logos, captions, speech bubbles, borders, and photorealism.
